Karnataka Government Launches Shakti Scheme for Women

The Karnataka government is set to launch the Shakti scheme, which will provide free smart cards to one crore women. This initiative aims to offer free travel on state-run buses to women across Karnataka. The scheme is part of broader efforts to support women's mobility and access to public services within the state. Details regarding the distribution of these smart cards and the exact commencement date of the free travel benefit are expected soon.
